text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in our DM. Moss's notes have two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers on the Eau Claire yard's 04:00 shift weren't getting SMS bay assignments at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed it was fixed.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags, and the ticket went to tier-2 support.

Moss's other two North notes mention the account but give no ticket numbers. Those are the pipeline digest from 14 Sep 2025 and the renewal check-in from 23 Mar 2026.

I told Dana to double-check #4419 before it goes in the weekly notes. Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 gives that same number to a different problem, printer lag at Gate 3, so one of the two is probably wrong. I also told Dana that I left out Quarendon Freightways, a similarly named company that isn't a customer.

I only used Moss's notes that are public in the North team digests folder, so nothing came from places Dana can't see. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so no approval was needed.
